description: Canonical persona, journey, user-story, flow, screen, component and diagram coverage for the complete PenniLogic Android, customer-web and admin products. Records are planning contracts and use synthetic data only.

personas.name: Debt-focused salaried adult
jobs: Understand payoff status and choose a feasible debt strategy

personas.name: Irregular-income household contributor
jobs: Stabilize spending and make progress despite variable income

personas.name: Manual privacy-first user
jobs: Track money and plan debt without granting capture permissions

personas.name: Automation-seeking Android user
jobs: Capture transactions and resolve only genuine ambiguity

personas.name: Financial planner and large-screen power user
jobs: Import, bulk-correct, analyze and compare financial scenarios

personas.name: Household owner
jobs: Share selected information and coordinate a joint goal

personas.name: Household member needing safe exit
jobs: Understand access and revoke, leave or conceal safely

personas.name: Split organizer or participant
jobs: Allocate, dispute and settle temporary group expenses fairly

personas.name: AI-assisted user
jobs: Obtain explanations while retaining provenance and control

personas.name: Support and privacy operator
jobs: Resolve customer and rights requests within required clocks

personas.name: Security and compliance approver
jobs: Review high-risk access, audit and incident actions safely

personas.name: Billing and AI operations manager
jobs: Change plans, quotas and providers without silent customer harm

journeys.name: First run to first debt-free status
Income, budget, goal and net-worth planning
Split group from invite to settlement
Household grant, joint goal and safe exit
System configuration, audit and release operations

user_stories.i_want: a safe launch, lock and adaptive shell
user_stories.so_that: I can return to my finances without exposing private data

user_stories.i_want: accessible authentication and account recovery
user_stories.so_that: I can regain access without weakening account security

user_stories.i_want: clear consent, age and permission choices
user_stories.so_that: I can use manual paths and grant only what I understand

user_stories.as_a: person working to become debt free
user_stories.i_want: a trustworthy home and debt management flow
user_stories.so_that: I can see progress and take the next feasible action

user_stories.i_want: neutral advanced scenarios with derivations
user_stories.so_that: I can choose a strategy without mistaking projections for guarantees

user_stories.i_want: accounts, transactions and statement import
user_stories.so_that: I can build a correct record and safely resolve conflicts

user_stories.i_want: capture health and focused clarification
user_stories.so_that: I can correct uncertainty without approving guesses

user_stories.as_a: person importing email or receipt evidence
user_stories.i_want: a local-first capture review flow
user_stories.so_that: I can add transactions without raw content leaving my device

user_stories.as_a: person with regular or irregular income
user_stories.i_want: income, budget and recurring planning
user_stories.so_that: I can plan realistic commitments as my income changes

user_stories.i_want: goals, net worth, holdings and reports
user_stories.so_that: I can understand progress without mixing currencies or certainty

user_stories.i_want: transparent expense allocation and settlement
user_stories.so_that: I can understand, dispute and settle only my fair obligation

user_stories.i_want: explicit grants, joint goals and a safe exit
user_stories.so_that: I can collaborate without surrendering private financial control

user_stories.i_want: explanations, drafts, history and provider controls
user_stories.so_that: I can use AI without letting it calculate money or act for me

user_stories.i_want: clear billing, notifications and retention choices
user_stories.so_that: I can control cost and reminders without coercive prompts

user_stories.i_want: trust, rights and support controls
user_stories.so_that: I can inspect access, request help and leave safely

user_stories.as_a: person on a constrained or shared device
user_stories.i_want: adaptive failures and a privacy-safe widget
user_stories.so_that: I can see appropriate progress without leaking financial detail

user_stories.i_want: authentication, recovery and a responsive shell
user_stories.so_that: I can work safely on desktop or narrow layouts

user_stories.i_want: account, transaction, import and export tools
user_stories.so_that: I can review and correct large data sets efficiently

user_stories.i_want: a dashboard and comparable strategies
user_stories.so_that: I can verify payoff progress and scenario tradeoffs

user_stories.i_want: debt entry and advanced scenario controls
user_stories.so_that: I can model changes without overwriting confirmed history

user_stories.i_want: a clarification inbox and reversible rules
user_stories.so_that: I can resolve ambiguity and undo an unsafe automation

user_stories.as_a: person planning across income and assets
user_stories.i_want: income, goals, net worth and holding analysis
user_stories.so_that: I can compare plans using traceable current values

user_stories.i_want: large-screen split management
user_stories.so_that: I can allocate, dispute and settle expenses transparently

user_stories.i_want: web-based grants, joint goals and revocation
user_stories.so_that: I can collaborate with the same privacy guarantees as Android

user_stories.i_want: assistant and provider controls on the web
user_stories.so_that: I can inspect provenance and keep every action under my control

user_stories.i_want: billing and notification preferences
user_stories.so_that: I can understand plan changes and control reminders

user_stories.i_want: trust, rights and support tools
user_stories.so_that: I can export, erase, revoke and seek help safely

user_stories.i_want: unambiguous multi-currency presentation
user_stories.so_that: I never mistake an unconverted or stale total for current value

user_stories.i_want: role-aware authentication and navigation
user_stories.so_that: I can reach only the capabilities I am authorized to use

user_stories.i_want: redaction, unmask and four-eyes controls
user_stories.so_that: sensitive access remains bounded, justified and independently approved

user_stories.i_want: joiner, mover, leaver and qualification workflows
user_stories.so_that: capabilities and approval eligibility expire correctly

user_stories.i_want: versioned plan, feature and quota controls
user_stories.so_that: changes are reviewable, reversible and never silently harm customers

user_stories.i_want: provider, routing, spend and kill-switch controls
user_stories.so_that: I can contain provider risk without exposing prompts or keys

user_stories.i_want: redacted cases, refunds and reconciliation
user_stories.so_that: I can resolve bounded requests without browsing customer finances

user_stories.i_want: clocked rights and grievance fulfillment
user_stories.so_that: I can complete or refuse requests with evidence before deadlines

user_stories.i_want: audit, monitoring and aggregate analytics
user_stories.so_that: I can detect risk without gaining a general financial browser

user_stories.i_want: governed production-access and restore reviews
user_stories.so_that: zero-standing-access and restore barriers remain provable

user_stories.i_want: immutable incident, red-team and release evidence
user_stories.so_that: I can act under pressure without editing the gate I review
